brief.title: Shopify Sales and Inventory Dashboard
brief.summary: The client wants a unified sales and inventory dashboard for two Shopify stores to track revenue, margins, inventory, and ad spend. This will eliminate manual spreadsheet tracking and provide better multi-currency and multi-channel visibility.
mustHaves: Ad spend from Meta + Google for ROAS per channel
Daily sync with history from Jan 2024
niceToHaves: Alert when a top SKU is under 14 days of stock
deliverables: Multi-currency support for CAD and USD
brief.budget: Budget is flexible for the right person; we'd start with a paid discovery call.

clientSignals.note: Clear scope defining exact data sources and metrics required.
Willingness to pay for a discovery call shows respect for the consultant's time.
Flexible budget indicated for the right person.

applicationInstructions: Tell us what you'd build it with and roughly how long.
questionsToAsk: What specific BI tool or tech stack do you currently prefer or use?
Do you have existing API access configured for Meta and Google Ads?
How are shipping costs and taxes factored into your current margin calculations?

requirements.evidence: Profile lists full-stack capabilities with PostgreSQL and Node.js to build reporting dashboards, but lacks explicit e-commerce margin tracking.
No mention of inventory management or stock forecasting in the profile.
No mention of SKU-level analytics or e-commerce catalog reporting.

requirements.requirement: Ad spend from Meta + Google for ROAS per channel
requirements.evidence: Profile has strong automation experience with n8n and Make connecting to various APIs, but no specific mention of Meta or Google Ads integration.

requirements.requirement: Daily sync with history from Jan 2024
requirements.evidence: Profile shows extensive automation and database experience for data syncing, but no direct Shopify API history sync projects.
Profile mentions being based in Canada, but contains no specific multi-currency financial handling experience.
Profile includes full-stack web development experience (Next.js, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) capable of implementing user authentication.

proofPoints.claim: Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Demonstrates the ability to handle data pipelines, API integrations, and scheduled syncs required for pulling ad spend and store data.

proofPoints.claim: Full-stack 7 years experience with Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Provides the foundational stack needed to build a custom dashboard with user authentication and database storage.

gaps.honestFraming: While I have not built inventory days-of-cover logic specifically, I have extensive experience building custom data pipelines and backend processing in PostgreSQL and Node.js to calculate and display complex metrics.

gaps.gap: Shopify and ad platform API integrations
gaps.honestFraming: I have built numerous API integrations using n8n, Make, and custom Node.js code, and can readily connect Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads APIs.

fit.angle: With 7 years of full-stack and automation experience using Node.js, PostgreSQL, and n8n, I can build a robust, custom dashboard that automates your data syncs and eliminates manual spreadsheets.

versions.proposal:
Unifying sales, inventory, and ad spend across two Shopify stores into one dashboard removes manual spreadsheet tracking and gives you clear multi-currency visibility.

You need automated daily syncs starting from January 2024, proper CAD and USD handling, inventory days-of-cover, and login access for four people.

With 7 years of full-stack experience using Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, I build custom dashboards with robust backend storage and user authentication. I also maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies, handling complex data pipelines, scheduled syncs, and API integrations.

I would build this dashboard using Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with n8n managing the daily data syncs from Shopify, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. The project would take approximately 3 to 4 weeks to complete.

Shall we schedule a brief call this week to review your exact data sources and user access requirements?

milestones.name: Data Pipeline and Database Setup
milestones.outcome: PostgreSQL database configured and automated daily syncs established for Shopify, Meta, and Google Ads via n8n starting from January 2024.

milestones.name: Backend Processing and Metrics
milestones.outcome: Calculations implemented for revenue and margin by product, top and bottom SKUs, inventory days-of-cover, and CAD/USD handling.

milestones.name: Dashboard Frontend and User Access
milestones.outcome: Custom Next.js dashboard deployed with multi-user login configured for 4 people and final review completed.

state.job:
Sales & inventory dashboard for our Shopify store (2 stores, CA + US)

We sell outdoor gear on two Shopify stores and track everything in spreadsheets. We'd like one dashboard: revenue, margin by product, inventory days-of-cover, top/bottom SKUs, and ad spend from Meta + Google so we can see ROAS per channel.

- Daily sync, history from Jan 2024
- CAD/USD handled properly
- Login for 4 people
- Bonus: alert when a top SKU is under 14 days of stock

Tell us what you'd build it with and roughly how long. Budget is flexible for the right person; we'd start with a paid discovery call.
state.profile:
Demo profile — replace with your own.

Full-stack & AI developer, 7 years. Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Python.
- Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice: online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, Stripe deposits. No-shows fell from 11% to 4% in 3 months.
- Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets), incl. lead scoring with an LLM.
- Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions. Answer accuracy went from 71% to 89% after retrieval tuning.
- React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
- AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3) and Vercel; CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Based in Canada (Eastern time).
